map.计算专利、商标、著作权的保护期届满日与剩余年限，提示续展/缴费时间节点。: Computes the expiry date and remaining years of protection for patents, trademarks and copyrights, and flags renewal or fee payment deadlines.
map.📖 查看「知识产权保护期 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to intellectual property protection periods
map.发明专利：申请日 2010-03-01，保护期 20 年自申请日起算，届满日 2: Invention patent: filing date 2010-03-01, protection lasts 20 years counted from the filing date, expiring 2030-03-01; annual fees must be paid every year to maintain it, and the patent right lapses if the fees are not paid.
map.注册商标：核准注册日 2018-06-15，保护期 10 年，届满 2028-0: Registered trademark: registration approved on 2018-06-15, protection lasts 10 years, expiring 2028-06-15; the renewal window is 2027-06-15 to 2028-06-15, with a grace period extending to 2028-12-15.
map.外观设计：2022-01-01 申请（2021-06-01 之后），保护期 15: Design: filed on 2022-01-01 (after 2021-06-01), protection lasts 15 years, expiring 2037-01-01; filings made before that date get 10 years.
map.算例：发明专利 20 年保护期: Worked example: the 20-year protection of an invention patent
map.申请日 2010-03-01，发明专利保护期 20 年，届满日 = 2010-0: Filing date 2010-03-01, invention patent protection 20 years, so expiry = 2010-03-01 + 20 years = 2030-03-01. If today is 2024-06-10, about 2090 days remain (about 5.7 years). Trademarks differ: approval date 2018-06-15 + 10 years = expiry 2028-06-15, and renewal can be filed within the 12 months before expiry (from 2027-06-15), each renewal lasting 10 years.
map.外观设计为何有 10 年与 15 年之分？: Why are designs protected for either 10 or 15 years?
map.2021 年 6 月 1 日第四次修正《专利法》施行后申请的外观设计专利保护期为: After the fourth amendment to the Patent Law took effect on June 1, 2021, design patents filed on or after that date are protected for 15 years, while those filed earlier are protected for 10 years; the dividing line is whether the filing date falls after 2021-06-01.
map.商标到期不续展会怎样？: What happens if a trademark is not renewed on expiry?
map.期满未续展且错过 6 个月宽展期的，注册商标失效，他人可申请注册；续展应在期满前: If it is not renewed on expiry and the 6-month grace period is also missed, the registered trademark lapses and others may apply to register it; renewal should be handled within the 12 months before expiry, and can still be done with a surcharge during the grace period.
